 Diwali, Chhath Puja To Bring School Holidays Across States In November
 BW Online Bureau
 Nov 02, 2026
 # November 2026 school holidays 
 # school holiday list 2026 
 # November school holidays 
 # Diwali holidays 2026 
 # Chhath Puja holidays 
 Schools across India may observe festival holidays in November 2026, with closures varying by state, local celebrations and individual school calendars
 Schools across India may observe multiple holidays in November 2026 on account of festivals such as Diwali, Govardhan Puja, Bhai Dooj, Chhath Puja and Guru Nanak Jayanti. However, the number of holidays will vary across states and regions depending on local festivals and the holiday calendars issued by respective state governments. 
 Students and parents should check their schools' official holiday schedules, as not all festivals are observed as public holidays across the country. Individual school policies may also affect the dates of closures. 
 List Of Festivals And Holidays In November 2026 
 The following festivals and observances fall in November 2026, with their holiday status varying by state: 
 November 1 (Sunday): Kannada Rajyotsava / Haryana Day – Karnataka and Haryana 
 November 6 (Friday): Dhanteras – Observed across India; not a universal school holiday 
 November 8 (Sunday): Diwali / Deepavali / Naraka Chaturdashi – Celebrated across India 
 November 9 (Monday): Govardhan Puja / Annakut – Uttar Pradesh, Delhi, Rajasthan and other states 
 November 11 (Wednesday): Bhai Dooj / Bhaiya Dooj – Several northern and western states 
 November 14 (Saturday): Children’s Day – Marked by school celebrations; not a general holiday 
 November 15 (Sunday): Chhath Puja – Bihar, Jharkhand, eastern Uttar Pradesh and parts of Delhi 
 November 16 (Monday): Veerangana Uda Devi Martyrdom Day – Uttar Pradesh 
 November 24 (Tuesday): Guru Nanak Jayanti / Gurpurab / Kartik Purnima – Punjab, Haryana, Delhi and several other states 
 The dates listed are based on festival observances and do not necessarily indicate school closures in every state. Students and parents should refer to official state government notifications and school circulars to confirm holidays. 
 Board Exam Preparation May Also Affect School Schedules 
 With several state boards announcing their examination schedules and others expected to follow, schools may also make arrangements for students appearing for Classes 10 and 12 board examinations. 
 Some institutions may conduct pre-board examinations or provide preparatory holidays to students ahead of their board exams. These schedules will depend on individual schools and the examination calendars of the respective boards.
